title: The sides share no key exchange method
fault: The server offers only key exchange algorithms the client refuses.
signature: no matching key exchange method found
prompts: Which algorithms does each side offer?
Who is old here: the client or the server?
hints: Run the command with -v, and read the negotiation lines from both sides.
The message names the stage that failed: key exchange.

reveal.wrong: The injection restricts the server to a legacy key exchange set, and your client refuses it.
reveal.fix: Align the algorithm sets: upgrade the old side, or add the algorithm to one side with care.
